name: Katagiri Aira
source:
A servant of the Black Rose House.

She is a cold and enigmatic woman with a masked expression, as she does not show her emotions.

Despite her quiet demeanor, her breasts are larger than those of Marie and Maria.

[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/title.html]official site[/url]]
